sentences.zh: 二十九章十一年減閏餘一一萬六百七十八年減一閏月 諸本「閏餘一，一」作「閏餘二」，「六百」作「一百」，「減」下有「右」字。

translations.literal: Twenty-nine sequences and eleven years reduce the intercalary remainder by one; in 10,678 years one intercalary month is reduced. In all editions "intercalary remainder one, one" is written as "intercalary remainder two"; "six hundred" as "one hundred"; beneath "reduce" the character "right" is superfluous.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-nine sequences plus eleven years reduce the intercalary remainder by 1; after 10,678 years one intercalary month is dropped. Editions read "run yu er" for "run yu yi,yi", "yi bai" for "liu bai", and add "you" under "jian".

sentences.zh: 按興和曆一章歲等於古法

translations.literal: Examining: the Xinghe calendar's one rule-year equals the ancient method
translations.idiomatic: Note: in the Xinghe calendar one rule-year equals the ancient method

sentences.zh: (十九年一章)

translations.literal: (nineteen years one rule)
translations.idiomatic: (19 years per rule)

sentences.zh: 之二十九章加十一年，而閏餘減一；

translations.literal: 's twenty-nine rule-years plus eleven years, while the intercalary remainder is reduced by one;
translations.idiomatic: —twenty-nine such rules plus eleven years, with the intercalary remainder reduced by 1;

sentences.zh: 積十九章歲，即一萬六百七十八年則減一閏月。

translations.literal: accumulated nineteen rule-years of years—namely 10,678 years—then one intercalary month is reduced.
translations.idiomatic: and nineteen rule-years of years (10,678 years) drop one intercalary month.

sentences.zh: 傳本將「閏餘一，一萬」之兩「一」字誤并成「二」字，「六百」誤為「一百」，又衍「右」字，今俱改正。

translations.literal: The transmitted text erroneously merged the two "one" characters of "intercalary remainder one, ten thousand" into "two," erroneously changed "six hundred" to "one hundred," and also superfluously added "right"—all now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: The transmitted text merged the two "yi" of "run yu yi,yi wan" into "er", wrote "yi bai" for "liu bai", and added "you"; all corrected.

sentences.zh: 閏月數 諸本「閏」訛「間」，今依文義改。

translations.literal: Intercalary month count. In all editions "intercalary" is written erroneously as "interval"; now changed according to the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month count: all editions read "jian" for "run"; emended by sense.

sentences.zh: 內分五萬七千二百四十四 諸本「二百四十四」作「一百八十四」。

translations.literal: Inner fraction 57,244. In all editions "two hundred forty-four" is written as "one hundred eighty-four."
translations.idiomatic: Inner fraction 57,244: editions read "yi bai ba shi si" for "er bai si shi si".

sentences.zh: 按以沒法八萬八千四百一十七除沒分六百一十五萬八千一十七，得經沒六十九、分五萬二百四十四。

translations.literal: Examining: dividing submergence fraction 6,158,017 by submergence divisor 88,417 gives canonical submergence 69, remainder 50,244.
translations.idiomatic: Check: 6,158,017 ÷ 88,417 = 69 canonical submergences, remainder 50,244.

sentences.zh: 數字顯誤，今改正。

translations.literal: The numerals are clearly erroneous; now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: The figures are clearly wrong; corrected here.

sentences.zh: 五月二十三分月之二十也 諸本「五月」作「周髀六」。

translations.literal: Fifth month, twenty parts of twenty-three parts of a month. In all editions "fifth month" is written as "Zhou Bi six."
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, 20/23 of a month: all editions read "Zhou Bi liu" for "wu yue".

sentences.zh: 按會數為五月二十三分月之二十的整日數，「周髀六」三字當衍，又脫「五月」兩字。

translations.literal: Examining: the conjunction number is the whole-day count for fifth month and twenty parts in twenty-three parts of a month; the three characters "Zhou Bi six" are superfluous, and the two characters "fifth month" are missing.
translations.idiomatic: Check: the conjunction number is the whole-day count for fifth month, 20/23 month; "Zhou Bi liu" is intrusive and "wu yue" is missing.

sentences.zh: 今改正。

translations.literal: Now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: Corrected here.

sentences.zh: 百七十三日 諸本「三」作「二」。

translations.literal: One hundred seventy-three days. In all editions "three" is written as "two."
translations.idiomatic: 173 days: all editions read "er" for "san".

sentences.zh: 按此數即上會數，「二」字訛，今改正。

translations.literal: Examining: this number is the upper conjunction number above; "two" is erroneous; now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: Check: this is the upper conjunction count above; "er" is wrong; corrected.

sentences.zh: 百七十三 諸本「三」作「二」。

translations.literal: One hundred seventy-three. In all editions "three" is written as "two."
translations.idiomatic: 173: all editions read "er" for "san".

sentences.zh: 按此數亦即上會數，「二」字訛，今改正。

translations.literal: Examining: this number likewise is the upper conjunction number above; "two" is erroneous; now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: Check: this too is the upper conjunction count; "er" is wrong; corrected.

sentences.zh: 周天用一日月行數除 諸本「日」上脫「一」字，「數」下脫「除」字。

translations.literal: Circumference of heaven divided by the one-day moon-motion number. In all editions one character is missing above "day" and "divide" is missing below "number."
translations.idiomatic: Circumference of heaven ÷ one-day moon-motion number: editions drop "yi" before "ri" and "chu" after "shu".

sentences.zh: 按周日為小周

translations.literal: Examining: circuit-day is the lesser circuit
translations.idiomatic: Check: circuit-day is the lesser circuit

sentences.zh: (即一日月行數)

translations.literal: (namely the one-day moon-motion number)
translations.idiomatic: (i.e., one-day moon-motion number)

sentences.zh: 除周天所得之整數。

translations.literal: the whole number obtained from dividing the circumference of heaven.
translations.idiomatic: the integer from dividing the circumference of heaven.

sentences.zh: 原文脫漏，今補。

translations.literal: The original text had lacunae; now supplemented.
translations.idiomatic: Lacuna in the original; supplied here.

sentences.zh: 周餘 諸本「周」訛「用」，今依文義改正。

translations.literal: Circuit remainder. In all editions "circuit" is written erroneously as "use"; now corrected according to the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: Circuit remainder: all editions read "yong" for "zhou"; emended by sense.

sentences.zh: 減半月小餘之外 按入交限數為會通減通數之半，除以日法，即得一百五十八度。

translations.literal: Outside subtracting half the month's small remainder. Examining: the entering-crossing limit number is conjunction-communicant minus half the communicant number; divided by the day divisor, one obtains 158 degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond subtracting half the month's small remainder. Check: entering-crossing limit = conjunction-communicant − half communicant; ÷ day divisor = 158°.

sentences.zh: 其餘數為十一萬六千五十八半。

translations.literal: The remainder number is 116,058½.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder is 116,058½.

sentences.zh: 此注或由錯簡，致與正文迥無關係，依術當作「一百五十八度外不成度之數」。

translations.literal: This note may be from displaced text, making it wholly unrelated to the main text; according to the procedure it should read "the number of incomplete degrees outside the 158 degrees."
translations.idiomatic: This gloss may be a displaced passage unrelated to the main text; procedurally it should read "the fractional degrees outside 158°."

sentences.zh: 命以紀算外 諸本「算」下脫「外」字，今依文義補。

translations.literal: Count from the era, outside the tally. In all editions "outside" is missing below "tally"; now supplemented according to the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: Count from the era, outside the tally: editions omit "wai" after "suan"; supplied by sense.

sentences.zh: 命如上 諸本「上」訛「止」，今依文義改正。

translations.literal: Count as above. In all editions "above" is written erroneously as "stop"; now corrected according to the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: Count as above: all editions read "zhi" for "shang"; emended by sense.

sentences.zh: 閏月有進退 諸本「退」訛「即」，今依文義改正。

translations.literal: Intercalary months have advance and retreat. In all editions "retreat" is written erroneously as "then"; now corrected according to the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary months may advance or retreat: all editions read "ji" for "tui"; emended by sense.

sentences.zh: 如章閏得一 諸本「如」訛「加」，今依文義改正。

translations.literal: As rule-intercalation obtains one. In all editions "as" is written erroneously as "add"; now corrected according to the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: As rule-intercalation yields one: all editions read "jia" for "ru"; emended by sense.

sentences.zh: 度餘三萬九千三百三十九 諸本「三十九」作「四十九」。

translations.literal: Degree remainder 39,339. In all editions "thirty-nine" is written as "forty-nine."
translations.idiomatic: Degree remainder 39,339: editions read "si shi jiu" for "san shi jiu".

sentences.zh: 按甲戌紀交會差二千六百五十二萬二千六百四十九除以日法二十萬八千五百三十，得交會差一百二十七度、度餘三萬九千三百三十九。

translations.literal: Examining: jiaxu-era crossing-conjunction difference 26,522,649 divided by day divisor 208,530 gives crossing-conjunction difference 127 degrees, degree remainder 39,339.
translations.idiomatic: Check: jiaxu-era crossing-conjunction difference 26,522,649 ÷ day divisor 208,530 = 127° with remainder 39,339.

sentences.zh: 「四十」乃「三十」之訛，今改正。

translations.literal: "Forty" is an error for "thirty"; now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: "Si shi" is a corruption of "san shi"; corrected here.

sentences.zh: 算外 諸本「算」下脫「外」字，今依文義補。

translations.literal: Outside the tally. In all editions "outside" is missing below "tally"; now supplemented according to the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: Outside the tally: editions omit "wai" after "suan"; supplied by sense.

sentences.zh: 其月朔則交會 諸本「會」訛「道」，今依文義改正。

translations.literal: Its month's new moon then crosses in conjunction. In all editions "conjunction" is written erroneously as "path"; now corrected according to the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: That month's new moon then crosses in conjunction: all editions read "dao" for "hui"; emended by sense.

sentences.zh: 即是不蝕度 諸本「蝕」訛「餘」，今依文義改正。

translations.literal: That is the non-eclipse degree. In all editions "eclipse" is written erroneously as "remainder"; now corrected according to the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: That is the non-eclipse degree: all editions read "yu" for "shi"; emended by sense.

sentences.zh: 餘為蝕分 諸本「為」下衍「餘」字，今依文義刪。

translations.literal: The remainder is the eclipse fraction. In all editions "remainder" is superfluous below "is"; now deleted according to the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: The remainder is the eclipse fraction: editions add "yu" after "wei"; deleted by sense.

sentences.zh: 甲戌紀遲差分二百三十五萬二千一百九十一 諸本「二百」作「二日」，「二千」作「三千」。

translations.literal: jiaxu-era slow-motion difference fraction 2,352,191. In all editions "two hundred" is written as "two days"; "two thousand" as "three thousand."
translations.idiomatic: Jiaxu-era slow-motion difference fraction 2,352,191: editions read "er ri" for "er bai" and "san qian" for "er qian".

sentences.zh: 按以一紀月數二百八萬五千三百乘通數六百一十五萬八千一十七，以通周五百七十四萬五千九百四十一去之，得甲戌紀遲差分二百三十五萬二千一百九十一。

translations.literal: Examining: multiplying one-cycle month-count 2,085,300 by communicant number 6,158,017, removing communicant circuit 5,745,941, gives jiaxu-era slow-motion difference fraction 2,352,191.
translations.idiomatic: Check: 2,085,300 × 6,158,017, less communicant circuit 5,745,941, yields jiaxu-era slow-motion difference 2,352,191.

sentences.zh: 知「日」乃「百」之訛，「三千」乃「二千」之訛，今改正。

translations.literal: Knowing "day" is an error for "hundred," "three thousand" is an error for "two thousand"; now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: "Ri" corrupts "bai" and "san qian" corrupts "er qian"; corrected here.

sentences.zh: 所得為積周 諸本「為積周」訛「日餘周」，今依正光曆例改正。

translations.literal: What is obtained is accumulated circuits. In all editions "is accumulated circuits" is written erroneously as "day-remainder circuits"; now corrected according to the Zhengguang calendar example.
translations.idiomatic: The result is accumulated circuits: editions read "ri yu zhou" for "wei ji zhou"; emended per the Zhengguang calendar.

sentences.zh: 日蝕滿日法從日 諸本「日法從日」誤倒作「日從日法」，今依文義乙正。

translations.literal: Solar eclipse: when full according to day divisor, carry to days. In all editions "day divisor, carry to days" is mistakenly reversed as "days carry to day divisor"; now transposed according to the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: Solar eclipse: when the divisor is full, carry to days—editions reverse "ri fa cong ri" as "ri cong ri fa"; transposed by sense.

sentences.zh: 月行遲疾度及分 諸本「分」訛「合」，今依文義改正。

translations.literal: Moon's slow and fast motion in degrees and parts. In all editions "parts" is written erroneously as "conjunction"; now corrected according to the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: Moon slow-and-fast motion in degrees and parts: all editions read "he" for "fen"; emended by sense.

sentences.zh: 十四度

translations.literal: fourteen degrees

sentences.zh: 〈三百三十四分〉

translations.literal: 〈334 parts〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈334 parts〉

sentences.zh: 諸本「三十四分」作「三十十四分」，衍一「十」字。

translations.literal: In all editions "thirty-four parts" is written as "thirty-fourteen parts," with one superfluous "ten" character.
translations.idiomatic: Editions read "san shi si fen" for "san shi si fen", with an extra "shi".

sentences.zh: 按本表各項數字，今依下列方法加以校算：

translations.literal: Examining the numerals in each item of this table, they are now collated and calculated by the following methods:
translations.idiomatic: Each entry in this table has been rechecked by the following procedures:

sentences.zh: 月行遲疾度及分：以月日平行分七千五百一十三

translations.literal: Moon's slow-and-fast motion in degrees and parts: take the moon-and-sun parallel-motion fraction 7,513
translations.idiomatic: Moon slow-and-fast degrees and parts: use parallel moon-sun motion fraction 7,513

sentences.zh: (即小周)

translations.literal: (namely the lesser circuit)
translations.idiomatic: (i.e., the lesser circuit)

sentences.zh: 加減本日損益率

translations.literal: Add and subtract the present day's gain-and-loss rate
translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract the present day's gain-loss rate

sentences.zh: (損減、益加)，

translations.literal: (for decrease, subtract; for increase, add),
translations.idiomatic: (on a decrease entry, subtract; on an increase entry, add),

sentences.zh: 以章歲五百六十二約之為度，餘為分。

translations.literal: reduce by rule-year 562 to obtain degrees; the remainder is parts.
translations.idiomatic: divide by rule-year 562 to get whole degrees; the remainder counts as parts.

translations.literal: (ii)

sentences.zh: 損益率：以各日月實行度分化為分，減以月日平行分七千五百一十三即得。

translations.literal: Gain-and-loss rate: convert each sun-and-moon true-motion degree-parts into fractional parts, subtract the moon-and-sun parallel-motion fraction 7,513, and that is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Gain-loss rate: turn each day's true solar-lunar motion in degree-parts into fractional parts, then subtract parallel moon-sun motion fraction 7,513.

translations.literal: (iii)

sentences.zh: 盈縮并率：將本日前各日損益率累加得之。

translations.literal: Excess-and-deficit combined rate: accumulate the gain-and-loss rates for each day before the present day to obtain it.
translations.idiomatic: Excess-deficit combined rate: sum the daily gain-loss rates from the start of the period through the day before.

translations.literal: (iv)

sentences.zh: 盈縮積分：盈縮并率乘日法二十萬八千五百三十，約以小周七千五百一十三，即得。

translations.literal: Excess-and-deficit accumulated parts: multiply the excess-and-deficit combined rate by day divisor 208,530, reduce by lesser circuit 7,513, and that is obtained.
translations.idiomatic: Excess-deficit accumulated parts: multiply the combined rate by day divisor 208,530, then reduce by lesser circuit 7,513.

sentences.zh: 以下至校勘記[三七]，逕指出傳本譌誤所在，校改理由不再贅述。

translations.literal: From here down to Collation Note [37], the erroneous readings in transmitted editions are pointed out directly; reasons for emendation are not repeated at length.
translations.idiomatic: From here through Collation Note [37], each entry only marks where transmitted texts err; the rationale for each fix is not repeated.

sentences.zh: 盈七百五十七 諸本「十」下脫「七」字，今據校算補。

translations.literal: Excess 757. In all editions the character "seven" is missing below "ten"; now supplemented according to collation calculation.
translations.idiomatic: Excess 757: editions omit "qi" below "shi"; supplied per recalculation.

sentences.zh: 二百六十一分 諸本「二百」下衍「四十」兩字，今據校算刪。

translations.literal: 261 parts. In all editions the two characters "forty" are superfluous below "two hundred"; now deleted according to collation calculation.
translations.idiomatic: 261 parts: editions add "si shi" below "er bai"; deleted per recalculation.

sentences.zh: 益六百一十六 諸本「十六」訛「十七」，今據校算改正。

translations.literal: Increase 616. In all editions "sixteen" is written erroneously as "seventeen"; now corrected according to collation calculation.
translations.idiomatic: Increase 616: editions read "shiqi" for "shiliu"; corrected per recalculation.

sentences.zh: 盈一千四百四十六 諸本「四十六」訛「三十六」，今據校算改正。

translations.literal: Excess 1,446. In all editions "forty-six" is written erroneously as "thirty-six"; now corrected according to collation calculation.
translations.idiomatic: Excess 1,446: editions read "sanshiliu" for "sishiliu"; corrected per recalculation.

sentences.zh: 四百六十八分 諸本「六十八分」訛「八十六分」，今據校算乙正。

translations.literal: 468 parts. In all editions "sixty-eight parts" is written erroneously as "eighty-six parts"; now transposed according to collation calculation.
translations.idiomatic: 468 parts: editions read "bashi liu fen" for "liu shi ba fen"; transposed per recalculation.

sentences.zh: 二百六十七分 諸本「二百」訛「三百」，今據校算改正。

translations.literal: 267 parts. In all editions "two hundred" is written erroneously as "three hundred"; now corrected according to collation calculation.
translations.idiomatic: 267 parts: editions read "sanbai" for "erbai"; corrected per recalculation.

sentences.zh: 益六百四十六 諸本「四十六」訛「三十六」，今據校算改正。

translations.literal: Increase 646. In all editions "forty-six" is written erroneously as "thirty-six"; now corrected according to collation calculation.
translations.idiomatic: Increase 646: editions read "sanshiliu" for "sishiliu"; corrected per recalculation.

sentences.zh: 三百二十四分 諸本「三百」訛「二百」，今據校算改正。

translations.literal: 324 parts. In all editions "three hundred" is written erroneously as "two hundred"; now corrected according to collation calculation.
translations.idiomatic: 324 parts: editions read "erbai" for "sanbai"; corrected per recalculation.

sentences.zh: 十三度 諸本「十三」訛「十二」，今據校算改正。

translations.literal: 13 degrees. In all editions "thirteen" is written erroneously as "twelve"; now corrected according to collation calculation.
translations.idiomatic: 13 degrees: editions read "shi'er" for "shisan"; corrected per recalculation.

sentences.zh: 三百四十六分 諸本「四十六」訛「三十六」，今據校算改正。

translations.literal: 346 parts. In all editions "forty-six" is written erroneously as "thirty-six"; now corrected according to collation calculation.
translations.idiomatic: 346 parts: editions read "sanshiliu" for "sishiliu"; corrected per recalculation.

sentences.zh: 定大小餘 諸本「餘」訛「蝕」，今依文義改正。

translations.literal: Determine major and minor remainders. In all editions "remainder" is written erroneously as "eclipse"; now corrected according to the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: Determine major and minor remainders: editions read "shi" for "yu"; emended by sense.

sentences.zh: 積分盈者 諸本「盈」訛「盛」，今依文義改正。

translations.literal: Where accumulated parts are in excess. In all editions "excess" is written erroneously as "abundant"; now corrected according to the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: Where accumulated parts are in excess: editions read "sheng" for "ying"; emended by sense.

sentences.zh: 隨定大小餘 諸本「小」下衍「蝕」字，今依文義刪。

translations.literal: Follow to determine major and minor remainders. In all editions the character "eclipse" is superfluous below "minor"; now deleted according to the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: Follow to determine major and minor remainders: editions add "shi" below "xiao"; deleted by sense.

sentences.zh: 推日月合朔弦望度術第五 諸本「度」下脫「術」字，今依本術前後各標題例補。

translations.literal: Procedure 5 for computing solar-lunar conjunction, new moon, quarter, and full-moon degrees. In all editions the character "procedure" is missing below "degree"; now supplemented according to the pattern of section titles before and after this procedure.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure 5, computing solar-lunar conjunction, new moon, quarter, and full-moon degrees: editions omit "shu" below "du"; supplied per adjacent section titles.

sentences.zh: 不盡為餘 諸本「餘」上脫「不盡為」三字，今依文義補。

translations.literal: What does not exhaust becomes remainder. In all editions the three characters "what does not exhaust becomes" are missing above "remainder"; now supplemented according to the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: What does not exhaust becomes remainder: editions omit "bu jin wei" before "yu"; supplied by sense.

sentences.zh: 求次月次日日所在度 諸本「次月次日」作「日次月次」。

translations.literal: Find the degree where the next month and next day stand. In all editions "next month, next day" is written as "day next, month next."
translations.idiomatic: Find the degree where the next month and next day stand: editions read "ri ci yue ci" for "ci yue ci ri."

sentences.zh: 按依術文，先求次月日所在度，次求次日日所在度，傳本誤倒，今乙正。

translations.literal: Examining according to the procedure text: first find the degree where the next month's day stands, then find the degree where the next day's sun stands; transmitted editions have reversed this; now transposed.
translations.idiomatic: Note: per the procedure text, one first finds the next month's daily degree, then the next day's solar degree; transmitted texts reverse this; transposed.

sentences.zh: 逕斗除其分 諸本「逕」訛「遙」，今依文義改正。

translations.literal: Pass through Dipper and drop the fractional parts. In all editions "pass through" is written erroneously as "distant"; now corrected according to the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: Pass through Dipper and drop the fractional parts: editions read "yao" for "jing"; emended by sense.

sentences.zh: 以月周二十二萬五千三百九十乘之 諸本「周」上脫「月」字，今依文義補。

translations.literal: Multiply by lunar circuit 225,390. In all editions "month" is missing above "circuit"; now supplemented according to the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by lunar circuit 225,390: editions omit "yue" before "zhou"; supplied by sense.

sentences.zh: 求次月月度術 諸本「次月」訛「月次」，今據上正光曆例乙正。

translations.literal: Procedure to find the next month's lunar degree. In all editions "next month" is written erroneously as "month next"; now transposed according to the Zhengguang calendar example above.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to find the next month's lunar degree: editions read "yue ci" for "ci yue"; transposed per the Zhengguang calendar example above.

sentences.zh: 求次日月度術 諸本「次日月度」訛「月次日度」，今據上正光曆乙正。

translations.literal: Procedure to find the next day's lunar degree. In all editions "next day, lunar degree" is written erroneously as "month next, day degree"; now transposed according to the Zhengguang calendar above.
translations.idiomatic: Procedure to find the next day's lunar degree: editions read "yue ci ri du" for "ci ri yue du"; transposed per the Zhengguang calendar above.

sentences.zh: 小分三千四百六十七 諸本「七」作「一」。

translations.literal: Minor parts 3,467. In all editions "seven" is written as "one."
translations.idiomatic: Minor parts 3,467: editions read "yi" for "qi."

sentences.zh: 按以四除一經月度數：度二十九、大分八千九百四十五、小分六千九百一十九，得上弦度數：度七、大分六千四百五十一、小分三千四百六十七、微分二。

translations.literal: Examining: dividing one lunation's monthly degree count by four—degrees 29, major parts 8,945, minor parts 6,919—yields first-quarter degree count: degrees 7, major parts 6,451, minor parts 3,467, micro-parts 2.
translations.idiomatic: Check: dividing one lunation's degrees 29, major parts 8,945, minor parts 6,919 by 4 yields first quarter 7°, 6,451 major parts, 3,467 minor parts, 2 micro-parts.

sentences.zh: 小分尾數「一」字乃「七」之訛，今改正。

translations.literal: The terminal minor-part character "one" is an error for "seven"; now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: The terminal minor part "yi" is a corruption of "qi"; corrected here.

sentences.zh: 又加得望 諸本「加」作「如」。

translations.literal: Then add again to obtain full moon. In all editions "add" is written as "as if."
translations.idiomatic: Then add again to obtain full moon: editions read "ru" for "jia."

sentences.zh: 殿本考證云「如字當作加」，說是，今改正。

translations.literal: The Palace Edition textual note says "the character ru should be jia"; that view is correct; now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Edition textual note says "ru" should read "jia"; that view is accepted; corrected here.

sentences.zh: 降赤決溫陰雨 「降赤」，本志上正光曆作「絳赤」，疑作「絳赤」是。

translations.literal: Crimson fall, decisive warmth, yin rain. "Crimson fall": the Zhengguang calendar in this treatise above reads "deep crimson"; it is suspected that "deep crimson" is correct.
translations.idiomatic: Crimson fall, decisive warmth, yin rain: the Zhengguang calendar above reads "jiang chi" (deep crimson); "jiang chi" is likely correct.

sentences.zh: 日澤寒陰雨 「日澤、寒、陰雨」，本志上正光曆作「白濁、微寒、陰雨」，疑此「日澤」乃「白濁」之訛，又脫「微」字。

translations.literal: Sun marsh, cold, yin rain. "Sun marsh, cold, yin rain": the Zhengguang calendar in this treatise above reads "white turbidity, slight cold, yin rain"; it is suspected that here "sun marsh" is an error for "white turbidity," and the character "slight" is also missing.
translations.idiomatic: Sun marsh, cold, yin rain: Zhengguang has white turbidity, slight cold, yin rain; "ri ze" here is likely a corruption of "bai zhuo," and "wei" is missing.

sentences.zh: 鶡旦不鳴 諸本「鳴」上無「不」字。

translations.literal: The crossbill does not cry at dawn. In all editions "not" is absent above "cry."
translations.idiomatic: Crossbill silent at dawn: editions lack "bu" above "ming."

sentences.zh: 按本志上正光曆作「鶡旦不鳴」。

translations.literal: Examining: the Zhengguang calendar in this treatise above reads "crossbill at dawn does not cry."
translations.idiomatic: Note: the Zhengguang calendar in this treatise reads "he dan bu ming."

sentences.zh: 據禮月令作「鶡旦不鳴」，呂氏春秋仲冬作「鶡鴠不鳴」，淮南子時則篇作「鳱鴠不鳴」，則以有「不」字為是。

translations.literal: According to the Monthly Ordinances in the Rites it reads "crossbill at dawn does not cry"; Lüshi chunqiu, mid-winter, reads "crossbill and wren do not cry"; Huainanzi, Seasonal Regulations, reads "osprey and wren do not cry"—thus having the character "not" is correct.
translations.idiomatic: The Rites' Monthly Ordinances has "he dan bu ming"; Lüshi chunqiu mid-winter has "he dan bu ming"; Huainanzi Seasonal Regulations has "guan dan bu ming"—so the negative particle is warranted.

sentences.zh: 今據補。

translations.literal: Now supplemented accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Supplied here accordingly.

sentences.zh: 算外 諸本「外」訛「上」，今據正光曆推上朔法改正。

translations.literal: Outside the tally. In all editions "outside" is written erroneously as "above"; now corrected according to the Zhengguang calendar's procedure for pushing the upper new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Outside the tally: editions read "shang" for "wai"; corrected per Zhengguang new-moon procedure.

sentences.zh: 其數一百九十五萬三千七百一十六 諸本「十六」作「十七」。

translations.literal: Its number 1,953,716. In all editions "sixteen" is written as "seventeen."
translations.idiomatic: The number 1,953,716: editions read "shiqi" for "shiliu."

sentences.zh: 按辰星合終日數一百一十五乘以度法一萬六千八百六十，并以合終日餘一萬四千八百一十六

translations.literal: Examining: Mercury's conjunction-cycle day count 115 multiplied by degree divisor 16,860, and further adding conjunction-cycle day remainder 14,816
translations.idiomatic: Check: Mercury conjunction-cycle days 115 × degree divisor 16,860, plus conjunction-cycle day remainder 14,816

sentences.zh: (此數末位尾數「六」原文誤作「八」，參閱校勘記[六八])，

translations.literal: (The terminal digit "six" in this number was erroneously written as "eight" in the original text; see Collation Note [68].),
translations.idiomatic: (The terminal digit "liu" in this figure was written as "ba" in the source; see Collation Note [68].),

sentences.zh: 得一百九十五萬三千七百一十六。

translations.literal: obtaining 1,953,716.
translations.idiomatic: yielding 1,953,716.

sentences.zh: 尾數「十七」乃「十六」之訛，今改正。

translations.literal: The terminal digits "seventeen" are an error for "sixteen"; now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: Terminal digits "shiqi" are a corruption of "shiliu"; corrected here.

sentences.zh: 減合度餘 諸本「度」下脫「餘」字，今依文義補。

translations.literal: Subtract conjunction degree remainder. In all editions "remainder" is missing below "degree"; now supplemented according to the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract conjunction degree remainder: editions omit "yu" below "du"; supplied by sense.

sentences.zh: 加周虛 諸本於「加周虛」下衍「積年盡」三字，今依文義刪。

translations.literal: Add circuit void. In all editions the three characters "accumulated years exhausted" are superfluous below "add circuit void"; now deleted according to the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: Add circuit void: editions add "ji nian jin" below "jia zhou xu"; deleted by sense.

sentences.zh: 其求金水及命度 諸本「水」上奪「金」字。

translations.literal: Its finding of Metal, Water, and fate-degree. In all editions "Metal" is missing above "Water."
translations.idiomatic: Finding Metal, Water, and fate-degree: editions lack "jin" above "shui."

sentences.zh: 按上推五星術於求得冬至後晨夕合度算及度餘後，述求金、水冬至後晨夕合度及度餘術。

translations.literal: Examining: in the procedure above for pushing the five stars, after obtaining the tallies and degree remainders for morning and evening conjunction degrees after the winter solstice, it then sets forth the procedure for finding Metal and Water morning and evening conjunction degrees and degree remainders after the winter solstice.
translations.idiomatic: Note: after the five-star procedure obtains winter-solstice morning and evening conjunction tallies and remainders, it gives procedures for Metal and Water winter-solstice morning and evening conjunctions and remainders.

sentences.zh: 則此處不當單求水一星，今補。

translations.literal: Thus here one should not seek Water alone as a single star; now supplemented.
translations.idiomatic: This passage should not treat Water alone; "jin" is supplied here.

sentences.zh: 餘滿日度法從日 諸本「從」訛「後」，「從日」下又衍「一日」兩字，今依文義刪改。

translations.literal: When remainder fills day-degree divisor, carry to days. In all editions "carry" is written erroneously as "after"; below "carry to days" the two characters "one day" are also superfluous; now deleted and changed according to the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: When remainder fills day-degree divisor, carry to days: editions read "hou" for "cong," and add "yi ri" below "cong ri"; deleted and emended by sense.

sentences.zh: 以一合日數及合日餘加之 諸本「以一合日數及合日數」誤倒作「以合日數及一合日餘」，今依文義乙正。

translations.literal: Add the one-conjunction day count and conjunction day remainder to it. In all editions "one-conjunction day count and conjunction day count" is mistakenly reversed as "conjunction day count and one-conjunction day remainder"; now transposed according to the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: Add one-conjunction day count and conjunction day remainder: editions reverse this as "conjunction day count and one-conjunction day remainder"; transposed by sense.

sentences.zh: 度餘八千四百九十一 諸本「八千」作「九千」。

translations.literal: Degree remainder 8,491. In all editions "eight thousand" is written as "nine thousand."
translations.idiomatic: Degree remainder 8,491: editions read "jiu qian" for "ba qian."

sentences.zh: 按歲星數六百七十二萬二千八百八十八減以周天六百一十五萬八千一十七，餘除以度法一萬六千八百六十，得行星三十三度、度餘八千四百九十一。

translations.literal: Examining: Jupiter's number 6,722,888 minus circuit of heaven 6,158,017; the remainder divided by degree divisor 16,860 yields planetary motion 33 degrees, degree remainder 8,491.
translations.idiomatic: Check: Jupiter number 6,722,888 − circuit of heaven 6,158,017; remainder ÷ degree divisor 16,860 = planetary motion 33° with remainder 8,491.

sentences.zh: 知「九千」乃「八千」之訛，今改正。

translations.literal: Knowing "nine thousand" is an error for "eight thousand"; now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: "Jiu qian" is a corruption of "ba qian"; corrected here.

sentences.zh: 九十二日行四十八度而留 諸本「二」作「一」。

translations.literal: In 92 days it moves 48 degrees and stations. In all editions "two" is written as "one."
translations.idiomatic: 92 days, 48 degrees, then station: editions read "yi" for "er."

sentences.zh: 按熒惑日行二十三分之十二分，則九十二日行四十八度，不當為九十一日，今改正。

translations.literal: Examining: Mars's daily motion is twelve twenty-thirds parts of a day; thus in 92 days it moves 48 degrees; it should not be 91 days; now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: Check: Mars moves 12/23 of a degree per day, so 92 days yield 48°, not 91 days; corrected.

sentences.zh: 行星五十五度 諸本「十」下無「五」字。

translations.literal: Planetary motion 55 degrees. In all editions "five" is missing below "ten."
translations.idiomatic: Planetary motion 55°: editions lack "wu" below "shi."

sentences.zh: 按熒惑在日前後，伏行星度當相等，上文在日後伏作「行星五十五度」；

translations.literal: Examining: when Mars is before and after the sun, hidden planetary degrees should be equal; in the passage above, hidden after the sun reads "planetary motion 55 degrees";
translations.idiomatic: Check: Mars before and after the sun should have equal hidden motion; the passage above, hidden after the sun, reads "planetary motion 55 degrees";

sentences.zh: 依其伏、行、留、逆之總行度計，當以此數為是，傳本脫「五」字，今據補。

translations.literal: Calculating by its total motion in hiding, motion, stationing, and retrogradation, this number should be correct; transmitted editions lack the character "five"; now supplemented accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: by total hidden, direct, stationary, and retrograde motion this figure is correct; transmitted texts omit "wu"; supplied here.

sentences.zh: 度餘一萬五千六百八十一 諸本「度餘一萬」誤倒作「度一餘萬」，今依文義乙正。

translations.literal: Degree remainder 15,681. In all editions "degree remainder ten thousand" is mistakenly reversed as "degree one remainder ten thousand"; now transposed according to the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: Degree remainder 15,681: editions read "du yi yu wan" for "du yu yi wan"; transposed by sense.

sentences.zh: 九十一日行一百一十二度 諸本「一百」作「二百」。

translations.literal: In 91 days it moves 112 degrees. In all editions "one hundred" is written as "two hundred."
translations.idiomatic: 91 days, 112 degrees: editions read "er bai" for "yi bai."

sentences.zh: 按太白日行一度十三分之三，乘以九十一，則得一百一十二度，「二」字訛，今改正。

translations.literal: Examining: Venus's daily motion is one degree and three thirteenths; multiplied by 91 yields 112 degrees; the character "two" is erroneous; now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: Check: Venus at 1° 3/13 per day × 91 = 112°; "er" is wrong; corrected.

sentences.zh: 九十一日行一百五度 諸本「五」上脫「一百」。

translations.literal: In 91 days it moves 105 degrees. In all editions "one hundred" is missing above "five."
translations.idiomatic: 91 days, 105 degrees: editions omit "yi bai" above "wu."

sentences.zh: 按太白日行一度十三分之二，乘以九十一日，應行一百五度；

translations.literal: Examining: Venus's daily motion is one degree and two thirteenths; multiplied by 91 days it should move 105 degrees;
translations.idiomatic: Check: Venus at 1° 2/13 per day × 91 days should yield 105°;

sentences.zh: 下太白在日后，以同速運行九十一日，正作「一百五度」。

translations.literal: below, Venus after the sun, running 91 days at the same speed, correctly reads "105 degrees."
translations.idiomatic: Below, Venus after the sun at the same speed for 91 days correctly reads "105 degrees."

sentences.zh: 今據補。

translations.literal: Now supplemented accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Supplied here accordingly.

sentences.zh: 順大遲日行十五分之十一 諸本「遲」作「疾」。

translations.literal: Prograde, great slow: daily motion eleven fifteenths. In all editions "slow" is written as "fast."
translations.idiomatic: Prograde, great slow, 11/15 per day: editions read "ji" for "chi."

sentences.zh: 按太白日行十五分之十一為最遲，不當為大疾，今改正。

translations.literal: Examining: Venus's motion of eleven fifteenths is the slowest; it should not be great fast; now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: Check: Venus at 11/15 is slowest motion; it cannot read great fast; corrected.

sentences.zh: 日行一度十三分之三 諸本下「三」字作「二」。

translations.literal: Daily motion one degree and three thirteenths. In all editions the character "three" below is written as "two."
translations.idiomatic: Daily motion 1° 3/13: editions read "er" for "san" below.

sentences.zh: 按以九十一除一百一十二度，得日行一度十三分之三。

translations.literal: Examining: dividing 112 degrees by 91 yields daily motion one degree and three thirteenths.
translations.idiomatic: Check: 112° ÷ 91 = 1° 3/13 per day.

sentences.zh: 「二」乃「三」之訛，今改正。

translations.literal: "Two" is an error for "three"; now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: "Er" is a corruption of "san"; corrected here.

sentences.zh: 合終日餘一萬四千八百一十六 諸本「十六」作「十八」。

translations.literal: Conjunction-cycle day remainder 14,816. In all editions "sixteen" is written as "eighteen."
translations.idiomatic: Conjunction-cycle day remainder 14,816: editions read "shiba" for "shiliu."

sentences.zh: 按以度法一萬六千八百六十除辰星數一百九十五萬三千七百一十七，得合終日數一百一十五，合終日餘一萬四千八百一十六；

translations.literal: Examining: dividing Mercury's number 1,953,717 by degree divisor 16,860 yields conjunction-cycle day count 115, conjunction-cycle day remainder 14,816;
translations.idiomatic: Check: Mercury number 1,953,717 ÷ degree divisor 16,860 = conjunction-cycle days 115, day remainder 14,816;

sentences.zh: 而以周虛二千四十四減度法一萬六千八百六十，所得日餘亦同，足證末位尾數當為「六」。

translations.literal: and subtracting circuit void 2,044 from degree divisor 16,860, the day remainder obtained is likewise the same—sufficient proof that the terminal digit should be "six."
translations.idiomatic: subtracting circuit void 2,044 from degree divisor 16,860 yields the same day remainder—confirming the terminal digit should be "liu."

sentences.zh: 今改正。

translations.literal: Now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: Corrected here.

sentences.zh: 度餘一萬五千八百三十八 諸本「三十八」作「四十八」。

translations.literal: Degree remainder 15,838. In all editions "thirty-eight" is written as "forty-eight."
translations.idiomatic: Degree remainder 15,838: editions read "siba" for "sanba."

sentences.zh: 按以二除辰星合終日數一百一十五、日餘一萬四千八百一十六，得行星度五十七、度餘一萬五千八百三十八。

translations.literal: Examining: dividing Mercury's conjunction-cycle day count 115 and day remainder 14,816 by 2 yields planetary motion 57 degrees, degree remainder 15,838.
translations.idiomatic: Check: Mercury conjunction-cycle days 115 and day remainder 14,816 ÷ 2 = planetary motion 57° with remainder 15,838.

sentences.zh: 知「四十八」乃「三十八」之訛，今改正。

translations.literal: Knowing "forty-eight" is an error for "thirty-eight"; now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: "Siba" is a corruption of "sanba"; corrected here.

sentences.zh: 日餘一萬五千八百三十八行星三十四度度餘一萬五千八百三十八 諸本日餘末兩位數「三十八」作「四十八」，其下並脫「行星三十四度、度餘一萬五千八百三十八」數字。

translations.literal: Day remainder 15,838; planetary motion 34 degrees; degree remainder 15,838. In all editions the last two digits of day remainder "thirty-eight" are written as "forty-eight"; below that, "planetary motion 34 degrees, degree remainder 15,838." are also missing.
translations.idiomatic: Day remainder 15,838; planetary motion 34°; degree remainder 15,838: in editions the last two digits "thirty-eight" of the day remainder appear as "forty-eight", and below they omit the seventeen characters "planetary motion 34 degrees, degree remainder 15,838."

sentences.zh: 按辰星在日前后之伏行留逆互為對稱。

translations.literal: Examining: Mercury's hiding, motion, stationing, and retrogradation before and after the sun are mutually symmetrical.
translations.idiomatic: Check: Mercury's hidden, direct, stationary, and retrograde phases before and after the sun are symmetric.

sentences.zh: 下文在日後晨伏東方項下作：「十七日、日餘一萬五千八百三十八」，其下有「行星三十四度、度餘一萬五千八百三十八」十七字。

translations.literal: In the passage below, under the item morning hidden east after the sun, it reads: "17 days, day remainder 15,838," and below that has the seventeen characters "planetary motion 34 degrees, degree remainder 15,838."
translations.idiomatic: Below, under morning hidden east after the sun, it reads "17 days, day remainder 15,838," and below that has the seventeen characters "planetary motion 34 degrees, degree remainder 15,838."

sentences.zh: 其在日前後伏行留逆之總日數各為五十七日、日餘一萬五千八百三十八，總行度各為五十七度、度餘一萬五千八百三十八，知此處脫文。

translations.literal: Its total day counts for hiding, motion, stationing, and retrogradation before and after the sun are each 57 days, day remainder 15,838; total motion in degrees is each 57 degrees, degree remainder 15,838—knowing that here text is missing.
translations.idiomatic: Total days and remainders for hidden, direct, stationary, and retrograde motion before and after the sun are each 57 days with remainder 15,838, and total degrees each 57° with remainder 15,838—showing text is missing here.

sentences.zh: 今改補。

translations.literal: Now emended and supplemented.
translations.idiomatic: Emended and supplied here.

sentences.zh: 度餘一萬五千八百三十八 諸本「三十八」訛「四十八」，今改正。

translations.literal: Degree remainder 15,838. In all editions "thirty-eight" is written erroneously as "forty-eight"; now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: Degree remainder 15,838: editions read "siba" for "sanba"; corrected here.

sentences.zh: 詳上條校記。

translations.literal: See the collation note in the entry above in detail.
translations.idiomatic: See the preceding collation note.

sentences.zh: 從全命之如前 諸本「全」誤作「令」，今依文義改正。

translations.literal: Follow the full fate as before. In all editions "full" is mistakenly written as "order"; now corrected according to the sense of the text.
translations.idiomatic: Follow the full fate as before: editions read "ling" for "quan"; emended by sense.

sentences.zh: 伏不書度 諸本「書」作「盡」。

translations.literal: In hiding, do not record degrees. In all editions "record" is written as "exhaust."
translations.idiomatic: In hiding, do not record degrees: editions read "jin" for "shu."

sentences.zh: 按李銳四分術注謂「伏不書度」云「謂不以所在宿度書於術」。

translations.literal: Examining: Li Rui's commentary on the Quarter-remainder procedure says of "in hiding, do not record degrees": "meaning one does not write the lodge-degree where it stands into the procedure."
translations.idiomatic: Note: Li Rui's Quarter-remainder commentary on "in hiding, do not record degrees" says this means not writing the lodge-degree of its position into the procedure.

sentences.zh: 李說是，於此亦然，「盡」當作「書」，今據改。

translations.literal: Li's view is correct; here likewise "exhaust" should be "record"; now changed accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Li is right; here too "jin" should read "shu"; emended accordingly.

sentences.zh: 前後相御 諸本「相御」下衍「十四」兩字，今據晉書卷一七律曆志中載景初曆五星曆步術文刪。

translations.literal: Before and after mutually govern. In all editions the two characters "fourteen" are superfluous below "mutually govern"; now deleted according to the Jingchu calendar five-star step procedure text as recorded in Jin shu, fascicle 17, Treatise on Music and Calendars, middle.
translations.idiomatic: Before and after mutually govern: editions add "shi si" below "xiang yu"; deleted per Jin shu 17, Treatise on Music and Calendars, Jingchu calendar five-star step procedure.
